title: Ya Abul Fazlil Abbas Ya Abul Fazlil Abbas
body:
SAQQAE SAKEENA HAI AUR SHABBIR KI ALMAAS
YA ABUL FAZLIL ABBAS YA ABUL FAZLIL ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
1. SOTE THE CHAIN SE TERE HIMMAT SE BIBIYAN
AB CHAIN BAAD ME TERE GHAZI UNHE KAHAA
AA LAUTKE MOQTAL SE BINTE ALI KI AAS
<<DIVIDER>>
2. AA DEKH HAAL KYA HUI HAAYE HUSSAIN KI
TOOTI KAMAR HAI RANME SHAHE MASHRAQAIN KI
KISKO BULAAYE KOI BHI MOUJOOD NAHI PAAS
<<DIVIDER>>
3. BAITHI HAI MASHK THAAMKE QAIME ME SAKEENA
LAB PER HAI ALLATASH TO HAI DIL ME  MADEENA
AB KAUN BUJHAAYEGA MAASOOMA KI PYAAS
<<DIVIDER>>
4. BHAI HUSSAIN KA HAI WAFAADAR HAI GHAZI
HYDER KE TARHA SHER ALAMDAAR HAI GHAZI
SAQQAI ME KAUSAR HAI MOQTAL ME HAI WANNAS
<<DIVIDER>>
5. ZAINAB KO BERIDAAYI SE AB KAUN BACHAAYE
BACHO KI PYAS KAUN BHALA AAKE BUJHAAYE
SOTA HAI ALQAMA KE KANAARE MERA ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
6. QAIME JALAYENGE TERE MARNE SE SITAMGAR
ZAINAB CHALEGI SHAAM KA BAAZAR KHULESAR
KYA BEETEGI BINTE ALI PE KUCH TO KAR EHSAAS
<<DIVIDER>>
7. UNNIS SAU HAI TEER JISM PAR HUE KHAAYE
SHABBIR KO GHERE HUE HAI ZULM KE SAAYE
AHLE HARAM KO HAAI MOHARRUM NA AAYI RAAS
<<DIVIDER>>
8. ALTHAF-O-ZAIGHUM KEHTE THE ROROKE YE HARAM
AA GHAZI BIBIYON PE KARDE TERA KARAM
AAKAR BACHAALE NEHR SE AHLE HARAM KI AAS.
